title: Need Your Transaction History? Our Team Can Help
summary: This document explains how to request detailed transaction history at Rho-Bank by contacting customer service (1-800-RHO-BANK, in-app chat, or rhobank.com/help). Representatives can pull complete checking/savings histories, including posted/pending transactions, descriptions/dates, fee breakdowns, rebates/credits, interest payments, and inter-account transfer details.
